text_block_list.text:
A few days after returning from summer training camp.
I ended up being late for training...
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you wait five whole minutes...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To be precise, you are 5 minutes and 23 seconds late.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Is something the matter?
You're not usually the type to be late."
choice_data_list: Maybe you're suffering from a bit of summer fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea.
Would you mind accompanying me starting tomorrow?
Knowing how thoughtful she is, I understood there had to be some meaning behind this proposal, so—
choice_data_list: Ah, sure thing!
Yeah, sure!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well then, tomorrow is—a complete day off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer.
It is now 12:35. Time for lunch.
choice_data_list: Wait. I took yesterday off, so I'll at least reply...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't wait. Please be punctual.
—I'll be closing your laptop now, alright?
choice_data_list: Ah, my work tools are...!
Ah, my work tools...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate a simple lunch break.
These small pockets of time are what's truly important, you know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.
choice_data_list: It's been a while since I had a nice, leisurely lunch...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Lately, it seemed like you were
often just grabbing quick bites in the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Twelve minutes remain until my next appointment at 13:25.
Let us enjoy our tea just a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. It is now 19:20.
Wrap up your work and prepare to head home.
choice_data_list: Yeah, got it. I'll get ready.
Yeah, got it. I'll get ready.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And also—this.
Please take it.
choice_data_list: Huh... Thanks for going out of your way!

text_block_list.text:
I took the paper cup from Eishin Flash.
The cafe latte soaked into my tired body...
Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, while you drink that, let's take about
five minutes to review everything we did today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Since you worked so hard today, Trainer,
I think you deserve some time to take a breather."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. ...Right on time.
It seems you've recovered quite a bit.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to you, Flash!

text_block_list.text:
Following her schedule and taking moderate breaks
each day, my physical condition was beginning to improve.
choice_data_list: Thank you for looking out for me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not something I need to be thanked for.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Do you remember? What happened at the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're staying late too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Deciding to do extra running
is just my personal plan.
I couldn't possibly drag you into it, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Not at all! Don't worry about me!
Not at all! Don't worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Why go that far?
choice_data_list: Because it's what I want to do.
Because it's what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand, Trainer? I have simply
returned what you gave to me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I simply did what I wanted to do.
choice_data_list: I see... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Um. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No, you're right.
I'm the one who should be thanking you, always.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now then, as for the schedule after this—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san seems to be lacking exercise lately,
so let's make good use of the stationary bike too.
choice_data_list: Ugh... T-This is getting rough...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Please do your best.
This schedule is necessary for you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because I want you to stay healthy, always.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I made a boxed lunch.
Would you like to eat together?"
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you!
W-Wah, thank you!

text_block_list.text: I open the wrapped bento box. Inside is a sandwich, thoughtfully balanced in everything from color to nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's nothing fancy, but...
Please, help yourself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Because I made it thinking of you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Alright... That finishes sorting the documents!
Yeah... And that's the document sorting done!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good work. —14:12.
Right on schedule. Truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If you faithfully follow
the schedule I gave you... like this—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So this is what it feels like. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...This time was supposed to be set aside for you to rest as you pleased, but..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't mind
tagging along to pick out my horseshoes?
choice_data_list: It's free time, so I can do whatever I want, right?
It's free time, so I can do whatever I want, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You truly are a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Käsekuchen—the cheesecake here—is exquisite,
so please, do try it together with some black tea.

I enter a cafe with Eishin Flash.
...Honestly, just as I was getting worried that there might be too many plans for our day off—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I believe you ought to change that mindset.
Resting is not laziness.
It is a "well-deserved" reward for all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just for now, forget about the time.
Please take a nice, relaxing rest.
